member.name: Etienne Bellerose
member.title: Candidate to the Embedded Systems Engineer profession
member.description: As a candidate to the Embedded Systems Engineer (ESE) profession, Etienne is involved in the software development and deployment. His technical skills were developed during his internship at Exonetik. With his analytical and cooperative spirit, developed among other things by his keen interest in board games, Etienne is one of the software team members essential to the company's success.
